title: I can Only Imagine
lyrics_original: I can only imagine what it will be like
When I walk by your side
I can only imagine what my eyes will see
When your face is before me
I can only imagine
Surrounded by your glory
What will my heart feel
Will I dance for your Jesus
Or in awe of you be still
Will I stand in your presence
Or to my knees will I fall
Will I sing hallelujah
Will I be able to speak at all
I can only imagine
I can only imagine
I can only imagine when that day comes
And I find myself standing in the Son
I can only imagine when all I will do
Is forever, forever worship you
I can only imagine, yeah
I can only imagine         ||Surrounded ||
I can only imagine
When all I will do

bible_verses.telugu: ఆయన దాసులు ఆయనను సేవించుచు ఆయన ముఖదర్శనము చేయు చుందురు; ఆయన నామము వారి నొసళ్లయందుండును.
bible_verses.english: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

bible_verses.telugu: ఇందును గూర్చిదేవుడు తన్ను ప్రేమించువారికొరకు ఏవి సిద్ధపరచెనో అవి కంటికి కనబడలేదు, చెవికి వినబడలేదు, మనుష్య హృదయమునకు గోచరముకాలేదు అని వ్రాయబడియున్నది.
bible_verses.english: However, as it is written: 'What no eye has seen, what no ear has heard, and what no human mind has conceived'— the things God has prepared for those who love him.

bible_verses.telugu: ప్రియులారా, యిప్పుడు మనము దేవుని పిల్లలమై యున్నాము. మనమిక ఏమవుదుమో అది ఇంక ప్రత్యక్షపరచబడలేదు గాని ఆయన ప్రత్యక్షమైనప్పుడు ఆయన యున్నట్లుగానే ఆయనను చూతుము గనుక ఆయనను పోలియుందుమని యెరుగు దుము.
bible_verses.english: Dear friends, now we are children of God, and what we will be has not yet been made known. But we know that when Christ appears, we shall be like him, for we shall see him as he is.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for the incredible promise of eternity with You. My heart fills with quiet wonder whenever I think about the day I will finally see Your face and stand in Your presence. Teach me to live today in the light of that glorious future, grounded in Your unending love. Whether I respond in joyful celebration or silent awe, I yield my heart fully to You. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for the incredible promise of eternity with You. My heart fills with quiet wonder whenever I think about the day I will finally see Your face and stand in Your presence. Teach me to live today in the light of that glorious future, grounded in Your unending love. Whether I respond in joyful celebration or silent awe, I yield my heart fully to You. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: This beloved song points us toward our eternal home and the overwhelming beauty of meeting Jesus face-to-face. It reminds us that while we cannot fully comprehend the magnitude of God's glory, our hearts can rest in the sweet certainty of what is to come. Whether we worship Him with exuberant praise or silent wonder, our ultimate hope is anchored in His presence. Today, let this melody lift your eyes from temporary struggles to the eternal love waiting for you in Christ.
